source.text_it: La frizione è raffreddata da apposita ventola

records.localized_text: The clutch is cooled by a dedicated fan.

source.text_it: In discesa è bene viaggiare con frizione premuta per ottenere un risparmio di carburante

records.localized_text: On descents, it is advisable to drive with the clutch pressed to save fuel.

source.text_it: In discesa è bene viaggiare con frizione premuta per evitarne il surriscaldamento

records.localized_text: On descents, it is advisable to drive with the clutch pressed to avoid overheating it.

source.text_it: La frizione a dischi multipli viene utilizzata se il cambio di velocità ha più di 4 marce

records.localized_text: A multi-disc clutch is used if the gearbox has more than four gears.

source.text_it: Il pedale della frizione va spinto con molta gradualità e va invece lasciato con movimento rapido e secco

records.localized_text: The clutch pedal should be pressed gradually and released quickly and sharply.

source.text_it: Il cambio serve a variare il rapporto fra i giri del motore ed i giri dell’albero di trasmissione e, di conseguenza, delle ruote motrici

records.localized_text: The gearbox varies the ratio between engine rpm and transmission shaft rpm and thus drive-wheel rpm.

source.text_it: In prima marcia, il numero di giri in uscita dal cambio è inferiore al numero di giri del motore

records.localized_text: In first gear, gearbox output rpm is lower than engine rpm.

source.text_it: Il sincronizzatore rende più agevole e silenzioso l’innesto delle marce

records.localized_text: A synchronizer makes gear engagement easier and quieter.

source.text_it: Nei veicoli pesanti, il cambio è spesso munito di riduttore che raddoppia di fatto il numero delle marce

records.localized_text: Heavy-vehicle gearboxes often have a reduction unit that effectively doubles the number of gears.

source.text_it: Nei veicoli pesanti, il riduttore del cambio consente di adattare più facilmente la potenza del motore alla variazione degli sforzi

records.localized_text: A heavy-vehicle gearbox reduction unit makes it easier to adapt engine power to changes in effort.

source.text_it: Il cambio non ha mai due marce con lo stesso rapporto di giri

records.localized_text: A gearbox never has two gears with the same speed ratio.

source.text_it: Il cambio di un veicolo pesante ha in genere più marce di quello di una autovettura

records.localized_text: A heavy-vehicle gearbox generally has more gears than a passenger car's.

source.text_it: Nei veicoli pesanti, il cambio è di norma munito di riduttore che serve a diminuire il numero delle marce disponibili

records.localized_text: A heavy-vehicle gearbox normally has a reduction unit to decrease the number of available gears.

source.text_it: Il cambio serve a variare il rapporto fra il numero di giri dell’albero di trasmissione e quello dei semiassi

records.localized_text: The gearbox varies the ratio between transmission shaft rpm and half-shaft rpm.

source.text_it: Il cambio è posto tra l’albero motore e la frizione

records.localized_text: The gearbox is located between the crankshaft and clutch.

source.text_it: Il cambio non ha mai più di 6 marce

records.localized_text: A gearbox never has more than six gears.

source.text_it: In prima marcia, il numero di giri in uscita dal cambio è superiore al numero di giri del motore

records.localized_text: In first gear, gearbox output rpm is higher than engine rpm.

source.text_it: I veicoli eccezionali non sono dotati di cambio

records.localized_text: Exceptional vehicles have no gearbox.

source.text_it: L’uso del cambio consente al conducente di variare la forza di trazione in relazione al carico del veicolo

records.localized_text: Using the gearbox allows the driver to vary tractive force according to vehicle load.

source.text_it: Il cambio serve a variare il rapporto tra i giri del motore ed i giri dell’albero di trasmissione

records.localized_text: The gearbox varies the ratio between engine rpm and transmission shaft rpm.

source.text_it: Il cambio permette di trasmettere alle ruote una forza variabile a seconda della marcia innestata

records.localized_text: The gearbox transmits a variable force to the wheels depending on the selected gear.

source.text_it: Più piccola è la marcia che si inserisce, più alta è la forza di spunto del veicolo

records.localized_text: The lower the selected gear, the greater the vehicle's starting force.

source.text_it: Quanto più "ridotte" sono le marce, tanto più elevata è la forza di trazione trasmessa alle ruote

records.localized_text: The lower the gears, the greater the tractive force transmitted to the wheels.

source.text_it: In genere, nei veicoli "pesanti", la leva del cambio non agisce direttamente sul selettore delle marce, bensì su di un servocomando di tipo pneumatico o idraulico

records.localized_text: In heavy vehicles, the gear lever generally acts on a pneumatic or hydraulic servo rather than directly on the gear selector.

source.text_it: Il cambio contiene olio lubrificante nel quale sono parzialmente immersi gli ingranaggi

records.localized_text: The gearbox contains lubricating oil in which the gears are partly immersed.

rows.text: The clutch does not require a dedicated fan: heat produced mainly during slipping dissipates through its components.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-clutch-failure-analysis-guide-service-and-troubleshooting-en.pdf — Introduction: heat is generated during slip and dissipated; fully engaged clutch has practically no heat or wear.

https://www-assets.liebherr.com/media/bu-media/lhbu-lwe/brochures/customer-magazine/2022_01/liebherr-upload-no1-2022-en.pdf — UpLoad 01/2022 pp. 86–87: dry clutch heat passes from pressure plate to air; wet clutch uses oil cooling.

rows.text: Keeping the clutch depressed downhill removes engine braking and reduces control. In a modern vehicle, staying in an appropriate gear with the accelerator released generally uses less fuel than coasting in neutral.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/general-rules-techniques-and-advice-for-all-drivers-and-riders-103-to-158 — rule 122: clutch depressed eliminates engine braking and increases downhill speed.

https://movingon.blog.gov.uk/2019/09/17/6-tips-to-improve-your-vehicles-fuel-efficiency/ — downhill, modern vehicles generally use less fuel in gear with accelerator released than coasting in neutral.

rows.text: The clutch need not be held down to cool it: when fully engaged, heat from slipping is practically absent. Pressing the pedal downhill also removes engine braking.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-clutch-failure-analysis-guide-service-and-troubleshooting-en.pdf — Introduction: heat is generated during slip and dissipated; fully engaged clutch has practically no heat or wear.

https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/general-rules-techniques-and-advice-for-all-drivers-and-riders-103-to-158 — rule 122: clutch depressed eliminates engine braking and increases downhill speed.

rows.text: A multi-plate clutch is selected according to the torque to be transmitted and the design, not because there are more than four gears.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/clutches-brakes/commercial-vehicle/eaton-heavy-duty-clutch-service-manual-installation-instructions-en.pdf — Appendix, clutch torque capacity: selection must accommodate peak engine torque; describes two-plate clutch.

https://vehiclelifetimesolutions.schaeffler.com/medias/BR-0007-en.PDF?context=bWFzdGVyfGRvY3VtZW50c3wzNDMxMTY0fGFwcGxpY2F0aW9uL3BkZnxkb2N1bWVudHMvaDE5L2gyZC85MzA1NTc1NzE4OTQyLnBkZnwwYzM2NTU3MzdlZGQ2YzY0YWZiNTE0MGZlN2E5ZjMzNTE5ZmY1YzdhYWM0Y2UxMzcyNmFkNTU2NGJmOTFkYzdk — p. 10: multi-plate module for higher engine torque.

rows.text: Press the pedal to disengage the clutch and release it gradually to reconnect the transmission smoothly; releasing it abruptly can make the start jerky.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carrying-out-driving-tests-examiner-guidance/11-guide-to-assessment-and-marking — control: use clutch and accelerator smoothly for a smooth start.

rows.text: Each gear selects a different ratio between engine and gearbox output; downstream, the drivetrain carries motion to the driven wheels.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/transmissions/commercial-vehicle-transmissions/transmission-ratios-and-specifications.html — EEO-14F112C table: distinct forward ratios including first 14.41 and twelfth 0.77, relating engine and output rotation.

rows.text: First is a reduction gear: the engine turns more than once for each output revolution. This reduction increases the torque available for starting.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/transmissions/commercial-vehicle-transmissions/transmission-ratios-and-specifications.html — EEO-14F112C table: distinct forward ratios including first 14.41 and twelfth 0.77, relating engine and output rotation.
https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76418.html — Ecomid: nine gears, crawler for high load/gradient and pneumatic Servoshift.

rows.text: The synchronizer uses friction to bring the gear and shaft speeds together before engagement, making shifting easier and quieter.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/mobile/en/company/strategy/heritage_zf/stories/all_synchronous_transmission.html — synchronizer friction equalizes gear and shaft speeds for silent engagement.

rows.text: A two-range reduction unit can provide two ratios for each gear in the main gearbox, doubling the number of combinations.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-fuller-heavy-duty-transmission-service-manual-trsm-0503-en-us.pdf — Operation RT-12515: five-speed main section with two-speed range provides ten ratios; deep reduction adds ratios.

rows.text: Extra ranges provide more ratios to choose from, helping the driver adapt available traction to changes in load and gradient.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-fuller-heavy-duty-transmission-service-manual-trsm-0503-en-us.pdf — Operation RT-12515: five-speed main section with two-speed range provides ten ratios; deep reduction adds ratios.
https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76418.html — Ecomid: nine gears, crawler for high load/gradient and pneumatic Servoshift.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE: a conventional gearbox selects distinct useful ratios to vary speed and torque. This does not establish a universal physical impossibility of duplicate ratios in every design.
evidence: Official superiori 29592 VERO. Eaton https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/transmissions/commercial-vehicle-transmissions/transmission-ratios-and-specifications.html provides a conventional transmission example with distinct ratios; no universal physical impossibility asserted.

rows.text: More ratios in heavy vehicles help select suitable traction for different loads and gradients; for example, some truck transmissions have 16 gears.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76419.html?pageLink=details_divider658792 — Ecosplit: 16-speed transmission for heavy trucks and special applications up to 120 tonnes.
https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76418.html — Ecomid: nine gears, crawler for high load/gradient and pneumatic Servoshift.

rows.text: The reduction unit does not reduce the number of available gears: adding a second range can multiply the ratios available from the main gearbox.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/transmissions/vehicle-transmissions/service-manuals/eaton-fuller-heavy-duty-transmission-service-manual-trsm-0503-en-us.pdf — Operation RT-12515: five-speed main section with two-speed range provides ten ratios; deep reduction adds ratios.

rows.text: The gearbox changes the ratio between the engine and transmission output. The ratio between the drive shaft and axle shafts concerns the final drive and differential.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/transmissions/commercial-vehicle-transmissions/transmission-ratios-and-specifications.html — EEO-14F112C table: distinct forward ratios including first 14.41 and twelfth 0.77, relating engine and output rotation.

https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/GOVPUB-W-6dfc6e0375832e323235f7e009fd2f76/html/GOVPUB-W-6dfc6e0375832e323235f7e009fd2f76.htm — TM 10-585 §§ 1, 44, 47: final drive connects propeller shaft to differential and reduces speed at axle.

rows.text: In the conventional layout the clutch is between engine and gearbox: it connects or disconnects the engine from the gearbox input.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/company/news-insights/news-releases/2024/eaton-introduces-aftermarket-endurant-automated-manual-transmission-clutch-and-flywheel-kits.html — flywheel is interface between engine and clutch.
https://www.zf.com/mobile/en/company/strategy/heritage_zf/stories/all_synchronous_transmission.html — manual shifting involves clutch and gearbox.

https://www-assets.liebherr.com/media/bu-media/lhbu-lwe/brochures/customer-magazine/2022_01/liebherr-upload-no1-2022-en.pdf — UpLoad 01/2022 pp. 86–87: clutch between engine and gearbox; input and output diagram.

rows.text: There is no general limit of six gears: some heavy-vehicle transmissions have many more, for example sixteen.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76419.html?pageLink=details_divider658792 — Ecosplit: 16-speed transmission for heavy trucks and special applications up to 120 tonnes.

rows.text: First gear reduces rotational speed: the output turns more slowly than the engine, not faster.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/transmissions/commercial-vehicle-transmissions/transmission-ratios-and-specifications.html — EEO-14F112C table: distinct forward ratios including first 14.41 and twelfth 0.77, relating engine and output rotation.

rows.text: Vehicles used for exceptional loads can also have a gearbox: they need ratios suited to moving very heavy loads.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76419.html?pageLink=details_divider658792 — Ecosplit: 16-speed transmission for heavy trucks and special applications up to 120 tonnes.
https://www.zf.com/products/en/special_vehicles/products_64416.html — TraXon Torque transmission tested in 250-tonne heavy-duty truck.

rows.text: Selecting a lower gear increases torque at the wheels, useful when a heavy load requires more tractive force.
evidence: https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76418.html — Ecomid: nine gears, crawler for high load/gradient and pneumatic Servoshift.

https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/transmissions/commercial-vehicle-transmissions/transmission-ratios-and-specifications.html — EEO-14F112C table: distinct forward ratios including first 14.41 and twelfth 0.77, relating engine and output rotation.

rows.text: The gearbox’s different gear pairs produce different ratios between engine speed and output shaft speed.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/transmissions/commercial-vehicle-transmissions/transmission-ratios-and-specifications.html — EEO-14F112C table: distinct forward ratios including first 14.41 and twelfth 0.77, relating engine and output rotation.

rows.text: Changing ratio changes the torque available at the wheels: a lower gear offers greater tractive force for the same engine torque.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/transmissions/commercial-vehicle-transmissions/transmission-ratios-and-specifications.html — EEO-14F112C table: distinct forward ratios including first 14.41 and twelfth 0.77, relating engine and output rotation.
https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76418.html — Ecomid: nine gears, crawler for high load/gradient and pneumatic Servoshift.

rows.text: A low gear multiplies engine torque more and provides greater force to start the vehicle, at the expense of speed at the same engine rpm.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/transmissions/commercial-vehicle-transmissions/transmission-ratios-and-specifications.html — EEO-14F112C table: distinct forward ratios including first 14.41 and twelfth 0.77, relating engine and output rotation.
https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76418.html — Ecomid: nine gears, crawler for high load/gradient and pneumatic Servoshift.

rows.text: A greater reduction multiplies the torque delivered to the wheels: at the same engine torque, available tractive force increases.
evidence: https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/transmissions/commercial-vehicle-transmissions/transmission-ratios-and-specifications.html — EEO-14F112C table: distinct forward ratios including first 14.41 and twelfth 0.77, relating engine and output rotation.
https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76418.html — Ecomid: nine gears, crawler for high load/gradient and pneumatic Servoshift.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE. In some heavy-vehicle manual gearboxes, pneumatic assistance helps gear selection and reduces effort; the linkage and layout depend on the design.
evidence: Official superiori 29605 VERO. ZF Ecomid https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76418.html describes pneumatic ServoShift assistance for a manual gearbox, not every gearbox or absence of a mechanical linkage.

rows.text: Gearbox oil reduces friction and wear. In splash lubrication some gears dip into the oil and distribute it as they rotate.
evidence: https://patents.google.com/patent/US8708105B2/en — transmission splash lubrication: lower gears partly submerged distribute sump oil.
https://lubricants.repsol.com/en/news/lubricacion-cajas-de-cambio-manuales/ — manual gearbox oil lubricates and rotating gears distribute oil in splash systems.

issues.reason: Il verdetto stampato VERO afferma senza eccezioni che nessuna coppia di marce ha lo stesso rapporto. La tabella di un singolo cambio non prova questa universalità; il brevetto citato descrive invece una configurazione con due marce avanti aventi lo stesso rapporto. Occorre stabilire se la domanda sottintenda un campo più ristretto e come conciliarlo con il testo stampato.
checked_sources: Quiz ufficiale superiori, quesito 29592, pagina PDF zero-based 111, SHA-256 a8bb47ac18788c151ba4596b4095221a4a2fce6f2cb026ffe671cf8283df9234: testo assoluto e risposta VERO.

https://www.eaton.com/us/en-us/products/transmissions/commercial-vehicle-transmissions/transmission-ratios-and-specifications.html — la tabella EEO-14F112C mostra rapporti avanti distinti per quel modello, non per tutti i cambi.

https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2009046807A2/en — il brevetto descrive una configurazione a doppia frizione con le marce V5H e V1L aventi lo stesso rapporto; descrive un progetto, senza stabilire il campo inteso dal quiz.

issues.reason: Il verdetto stampato VERO descrive come generale il comando della leva sul servocomando anziché direttamente sul selettore. Le fonti trovate documentano sistemi specifici e il comando pneumatico di gamma/splitter, ma non dimostrano tale disposizione generale per la selezione delle marce nei veicoli pesanti; resta da chiarire la portata del confronto con i sistemi servoassistiti meccanicamente.

https://www.zf.com/products/en/cv/products_76418.html — Ecomid prevede Servoshift pneumatico, senza descrivere nella pagina la relazione completa tra leva e selettore o la prevalenza del sistema.

https://www.parker.com/content/dam/Parker-com/Literature/France/France---Catalogs/Parker_Automation_Transportation_Global_CAT_1500_UK.pdf, p. 26, Easy Shift Range-Change Control — preselezione sulla leva e valvola pneumatica che aziona cilindri di cambio gamma/splitter; esempio limitato e non prova della disposizione generale.

ZF Ecosplit operating instructions, https://pdfcoffee.com/zfecosplit2001operatinginstructionpdf-4-pdf-free.html — Servoshift riduce lo sforzo e, se guasto, permette ancora di cambiare con forza manuale maggiore; la relazione con il selettore richiede chiarimento sul sistema specifico.
